macros.name: AddxmlBibResource
macros.doc: If a base name (either suffixed with .xml or not) for a TEI xml-compliant bibliographical database be provided, ekdosis will use it and insert formatted data in the back matter section of its own TEI xml output file, as <biblStruct> elements within a listBibl section.

macros.name: DeclareScholar
macros.doc: \DeclareScholar is used to build a list of persons within the <listPerson> element.

macros.name: DeclareScholar
macros.doc: \DeclareScholar is used to build a list of persons within the <listPerson> element.

macros.name: ekdmark
macros.doc: \ekdmark is an argument-less command called in commands used to make headers and footers where the marks stored by means of the mark optional argument of \ekddiv are to be printed.

macros.name: ekdpage
macros.doc: \ekdpage can be used at any point of the document to retrieve and print the current number.

macros.name: ekdpb
macros.doc: \ekdpb takes as mandatory argument the line number, as it is printed in the margin, where the page break should take place.

macros.name: ekdresethfmarks
macros.doc: \ekdresethfmarks can be used in rare cases when it is needed to reset headers and footers to their original, viz. printable state.

macros.name: ekdsetup
macros.doc: \ekdsetup is used to specify options that affect the general behavior of ekdosis.

macros.name: endmark
macros.doc: \endmark is an argument-less command that can be used just at the end of that portion of text to instruct ekdosis to print the last-emitted mark of the preceding page instead of the first-emitted mark of the current page.

macros.name: EnvtoTEI
macros.doc: instructs ekdosis how to convert LaTeX environments into TEI xml equivalents. It takes two mandatory arguments and one optional argument, namely the name of the LaTeX environment to be converted, the TEI element it is to be converted into and any additional attributes to be appended to the TEI opening element.

macros.name: MkBodyDivs
macros.doc: \MkBodyDivs is used to let ekdosis know which sectional commands are actually being used in an edition text.

macros.name: note
macros.doc: \note, when found outside \app{}, is used to insert in additional layers of the apparatus short comments or references to texts quoted or cited in the edition text.

macros.name: SetAlignment
macros.doc: \SetAlignment can be used either in the preamble or at any point of the document to set or to modify alignment settings.

macros.name: SetHooks
macros.doc: \SetHooks is used to set hooks meant to be shared by all declared apparatuses, such as the font size, the format of numerals, &c.

macros.name: setLR
macros.doc: \setRL and \setLR are two argument-less commands provided by ekdosis that can be used to change the writing direction of running paragraphs.

macros.name: setRL

macros.name: SetTEIxmlExport
macros.doc: \SetTEIxmlExport collects the settings to be applied to TEI xml export.

macros.name: SigLine
macros.doc: \SigLine returns three fields separated by the symbol & that is used in tables as follows: the siglum referring to the witness, the contents of the description field and the contents of the optional origDate field.

macros.name: teidirect
macros.doc: Two mandatory arguments are expected by \teidirect, namely the TEI xml element followed by the contents to be found in the ouput file between the opening and closing tags.

envs.doc: \begin{ekdpar} ... \end{ekdpar} is a simple environment that does nothing but insert \par primitives.
